statement: Priests wear the priestly garments during their service
note: No general record; C0301 (Law) covers undergarments when ministering, C0293 the high priest's robe; C0286 holds 28:2 for making the ephod.

statement: Do not loosen the breastplate from the ephod
note: Saints Greek order lacks MT Ex 28:28; C0366 itemizes the parallel Ex 36:28 as a garment specification.

statement: Do not tear the high priest's robe
note: C0292 covers making the robe's reinforced neck opening; Saints text has a purpose clause ('so that it is not torn'); no prohibition record.

statement: Priests eat the meat of the sin and guilt offerings
note: C0437 (sin offering, Lev 6:19) and C0445 (guilt offering, Lev 7:6-7); C0328 holds Ex 29:33 for the one-time consecration meal.

statement: A non-priest must not eat the most holy offerings
note: C0329 bars outsiders from the holy priestly portions at Ex 29:33.

statement: Burn incense on the golden altar every morning and evening
note: Daily sanctuary services (tamid C0333, lamps C0284, showbread C0264) are consistently Instruction.

statement: Offer nothing but the prescribed incense on the golden altar
note: Three Torah Law records itemize other incense, burnt or grain offerings, and libations separately.

statement: Give the half-shekel to the sanctuary each year
note: C0342 frames it as the census ransom of half a didrachma; Maimonides reads it as an annual levy.

statement: Priests wash hands and feet before sanctuary service
note: C0345 is Instruction despite 'perpetual statute' and 'so that they do not die'; the parallel undergarment rule C0301 (Ex 28:43) is Torah Law.

statement: Prepare the holy anointing oil
note: C0346 prescribes the oil's composition (a specification); ot-exodus-v30-31 holds 30:31 as a historical direction study.

statement: Do not anoint unauthorized persons with the anointing oil
Do not compound oil after the anointing-oil formula
Do not compound incense after the sanctuary formula
Redeem the firstborn donkey with a lamb
note: C0118 (Instruction) cites Ex 34:20; the same verses' 'redeem firstborn sons' (C0119) is Torah Law.

statement: Let the land rest from farming in the sabbatical year
note: C0227 (Ex 23:11 + Lev 25:2-4); Ex 34:21 itself is cited only by C0152 as weekly Sabbath rest.

statement: Appear before the Lord at the sanctuary on the three festivals
note: Only topical study S134 (Deut 16:16-17, Ex 34:23-24); Ex 23:17 uncited; C0230 (Law) covers keeping the feasts at Ex 23:14.

statement: Do not slaughter the Passover offering while owning leaven
note: C0235 cites Ex 34:25 as additional Scripture.

statement: Do not eat meat cooked with milk
note: No record states eating meat with milk; C0238 bars boiling (Ex 23:19 only); C0237 cites 34:26 for firstfruits. Saints 34:26 reads 'offer'.

statement: Courts must not carry out punishments on the Sabbath
note: Maimonides reads the verse as barring court executions by burning on the Sabbath; C0365 states only the literal fire prohibition.

statement: Offer the burnt offering according to its prescribed laws
note: C0371 holds Lev 1:2; the rite steps are Instruction records C0372-C0385.

statement: Offer the meal offering according to its prescribed laws
note: C0386 covers the grain offering's prescribed form with oil and frankincense.

statement: Do not offer leaven or honey on the altar
note: C0389 (leaven) and C0390 (honey); C0391 keeps the leaven-and-honey firstfruit gifts off the altar.

statement: Salt every offering brought to the altar
note: C0392 at Lev 2:13.

statement: Do not offer a sacrifice without salt
note: C0393 at Lev 2:13.

statement: Offer the peace offering according to its prescribed laws
note: C0394 holds Lev 3:1; the rite steps are Instruction records C0395-C1232.

statement: The court brings an offering for an erroneous ruling the people followed
note: C0400 bundles every offender class; its additional Scripture includes Lev 4:13-14 (the congregation's bull).

statement: An individual brings a sin offering for an inadvertent transgression
note: C0400 includes Lev 4:27-28, 32 as additional Scripture.

statement: Bring the sliding-scale offering for testimony, impurity or oath offences
note: C0411 covers the witness, impurity and oath offences with the poverty substitutions.

statement: Testify in court when one has relevant knowledge
note: C0409 at Lev 5:1.

statement: Do not sever the head of a bird sin offering
note: C0414 is a rite step for the officiating priest; the Lev 1:17 analog C0384 is also Instruction.

statement: Do not put oil on the sinner's meal offering
note: C0418 at Lev 5:11.

statement: Do not put frankincense on the sinner's meal offering
note: C0419 at Lev 5:11.

statement: Bring a definite guilt offering for sacrilege, theft and similar
note: C0422 (misuse of holy things, Lev 5:15-16) and C0426 (dishonest dealings and false oaths, Lev 5:25-26).

statement: Repay misused sacred property plus a fifth
note: C0423 at Lev 5:16.

statement: Bring a suspended guilt offering when unsure whether one sinned
Return robbed or wrongfully held property to its owner
note: C0425 at Lev 5:23-24, with the added fifth.

statement: Remove ashes from the altar daily
note: C0431 with C0430 and C0432-C0433; a sanctuary procedure.

statement: Keep a fire burning continually on the altar
note: C0428 cites Lev 6:5-6 as additional Scripture.

statement: Do not extinguish the altar fire
note: C0429 cites Lev 6:5-6 as additional Scripture.

statement: Priests eat the remainder of the meal offerings
note: C0388 cites Lev 6:9, 11 as additional Scripture.

statement: Do not bake the meal-offering remainder with leaven
The high priest offers a meal offering every morning and evening
note: C0434; consistent with the daily tamid (C0333), also Instruction.

statement: Do not eat a priest's meal offering
note: C0436 at Lev 6:16.

statement: Perform the sin offering service according to its laws
note: Rite records are Instruction (C0402 cites 6:18); C0400 (Law) covers the obligation to bring one, C0437 the priests' eating.

statement: Do not eat sin offerings whose blood enters the Sanctuary
note: C0441 at Lev 6:23.

statement: Perform the guilt offering service according to its laws
note: Lev 7:1 uncited; rite steps 7:2-5 are Instruction; C0445 (Law) covers priests' eating, C0422/C0424/C0426 the obligations.

statement: Burn sacrificial meat left beyond its time (notar)
note: C0452 (cites Lev 19:6); a disposal step, consistent with C0100 and C0330.

statement: Do not eat piggul, an offering invalidated by improper intent
note: C0453 gives the plain third-day eating reading (Maimonides' notar territory); piggul from improper intent is not stated.

statement: Burn sacrificial meat that has become unclean
note: C0455; a disposal step.

statement: Do not eat sacrificial meat that has become unclean
note: C0454 at Lev 7:19.

statement: Do not eat forbidden fat (chelev)
note: C0399 cites Lev 7:23, 25 as additional Scripture.

statement: Do not eat blood
note: Only Genesis indexed record C0019 (adds Lev 7:26-27, Deut 12); no Torah Law record; Lev 17:10-12, 14 cited by no record.

statement: A priest must not enter the Sanctuary with unkempt hair
note: M010 (historical direction) states it for that occasion; the standing high-priest parallel C0661 (Lev 21:10) is Torah Law.

statement: A priest must not enter the Sanctuary in torn garments
note: M011 (historical direction) states it for that occasion; the standing high-priest parallel C0662 (Lev 21:10) is Torah Law.

statement: A priest must not leave the Sanctuary during service
note: M013 (historical direction) states it for that occasion; the high-priest parallel C0664 (Lev 21:12) is Torah Law.

statement: A priest must not enter the Sanctuary or serve intoxicated
note: C0463 at Lev 10:9.

statement: Examine land animals for the kosher signs: split hoof, cud
note: C0467 states the hoof-and-cud criteria as a prohibition; no positive 'these you may eat' record (cf. birds, AUD-05-14-11).

statement: Observe the impurity laws of animal carcasses (nevelah)
note: C0472 (carcass contact, Lev 11:24-31) and C0468 (11:8); Lev 11:39 is uncited and 11:40 only in Instruction C0478.

statement: Examine fish for the kosher signs: fins and scales
note: C0469 holds 11:9 and states the fins-and-scales criterion as a prohibition.

statement: Do not eat non-kosher fish
Do not eat non-kosher birds
Examine locusts for the kosher signs
note: C0471 includes the permitted-locust criteria of Lev 11:21-22.

statement: Observe the impurity of the eight creeping creatures
note: C0472 covers the creeping-creature list of Lev 11:29-31.

statement: Food and drink become susceptible to impurity through liquids
Do not eat swarming creatures of the land
Do not eat worms found in fruit once they emerge
note: C0479 states the Lev 11:42 ban generally; Maimonides' fruit-worm application is not specified.

statement: Do not eat any swarming creature, including small water creatures
note: C0479 covers Lev 11:43 within one general ground-creature record.

statement: Do not eat creeping things that breed in decaying matter
note: C0479 covers Lev 11:44 ('do not defile yourselves') within one general ground-creature record.

statement: Observe the impurity laws of a woman after childbirth
note: C0480 at Lev 12:2.

statement: An unclean person must not eat sacrificial food
note: C0456 (eating while unclean, Lev 7:20-21) and C0481 at the source verse.

statement: A woman after childbirth brings her purification offerings
Observe the laws of skin-disease impurity in a person
note: C0485 diagnostic procedure (with C0484, C0486); the afflicted person's conduct rules C0490-C0494 are Torah Law.

statement: Do not shave the hair of a scall (nesek)
note: C0489 framed as a step of the examination procedure.

statement: The afflicted person rends garments, bares head, covers lip, announces uncleanness
note: Four Torah Law records itemize each sign at Lev 13:45.

statement: Observe the laws of skin-disease impurity in garments
note: C0496 and C0498 with C0495, C0497, C0499-C0500; procedures.

statement: Purify the healed metzora with birds, cedar, scarlet and hyssop
note: C0502 and C0501 with C0503-C0506; purification steps.

statement: The healed metzora shaves all his hair
note: C0508; a purification step.

statement: The healed metzora brings his purification offerings
Observe the laws of skin-disease impurity in houses
note: C0521 (cites 14:44) with C0519-C0526; C0527 (Law) covers only the uncleanness of entering the house.

statement: Observe the impurity laws of a man with a discharge (zav)
A man cured of a discharge brings his offering
note: Instruction, while the woman's parallel (AUD-03-15-29), childbirth (C0483) and metzora (C0511) offerings are Torah Law.

statement: Observe the impurity of a seminal emission
Immerse in water to become ritually pure
note: C0543 and the other bathing steps (C0509, C0535, C0541) are Instruction; purification steps.

statement: Observe the impurity laws of a menstruating woman (niddah)
note: Lev 15:19-24 has no C/AUD record, only topical study S062; parallel discharge rules (C0533, AUD-03-15-25) are Torah Law.

statement: Observe the impurity laws of a woman with irregular flow (zavah)
note: AUD-03-15-25 at Lev 15:25-26 (the list cites 15:19).

statement: A woman cured of an irregular flow brings her offering
note: AUD-03-15-29, with AUD-03-15-28 (count seven days) and AUD-03-15-30 (priest offers) as Instructions.

statement: Perform the Day of Atonement service
note: C0570 (annual atonement) and C0548 (animals); the individual rite steps are Instruction.

statement: A priest must not enter the inner Sanctuary at will
note: C0547 at Lev 16:2.

statement: Rest from work on the Day of Atonement
Fast (afflict oneself) on the Day of Atonement
Do not slaughter sacrificial animals outside the Sanctuary court
note: C0571 states the Lev 17:3-5 law positively: bring the sacrifices to the sanctuary.

statement: Cover the blood of slaughtered wild animals and birds
note: C0574 (Instruction) states it, but it is an everyday rule for every hunter, not a sanctuary or purification procedure.

statement: Do not engage in intimacy, such as embracing, with forbidden relatives
note: C0576 states the umbrella ban on relations with kin; Maimonides' separate ban on non-coital intimacy is not stated.

statement: Do not have relations with your mother
note: C0578 at Lev 18:7.

statement: Do not have relations with your father
note: C0577 itemizes the father clause; the catalogue flags for review whether it is a distinct act.

statement: Do not have relations with your father's wife
note: C0579 at Lev 18:8.

statement: Do not have relations with your sister
note: C0580 at Lev 18:9 (with Lev 20:17, Deut 27:22).

statement: Do not have relations with your son's daughter
note: C0581 covers a granddaughter through either child.

statement: Do not have relations with your daughter's daughter
note: C0581 covers a granddaughter through either child.

statement: Do not have relations with your daughter
note: No record names one's own daughter; C0581 (18:10) covers granddaughters, C0587 (18:17) a woman with her daughter.

statement: Do not have relations with your father's wife's daughter
note: Lev 18:11 is cited by no record; C0580's sister-or-half-sister scope (18:9, 20:17, Deut 27:22) covers her.

statement: Do not have relations with your father's sister
Do not have relations with your mother's sister
